[SWS_FrTrcv_00019] ⌈Configurability of optional functionality. Optional functionality
of a Basic–SW component that is not required in the ECU shall be configurable at
pre–compile–time (on/off).
If branches of active stars using [ECUC_FrTrcv_00357] are configured, these additional
APIs shall be available:
• The API to enable branches [SWS_FrTrcv_00443]
• The API to disable branches [SWS_FrTrcv_00442]
• The API to detect errors of branches [SWS_FrTrcv_00419]
⌋(SRS_BSW_00171)
